_notes: The STYLE LOCK. Locked values are added to every prompt - this is what makes a batch of 10 images look like one shoot.
'look'      -> applies to EVERY use case (colour grade, materials, mood).
'studio'    -> applies only to the use cases listed in 'studio_use_cases' (clean studio setups).
Lifestyle / concept / historical shots keep the photographic direction their recipe defines,
so a street scene never inherits a seamless studio backdrop.
Resolution order per prompt line: request-sheet column -> brand lock -> recipe default.
Empty strings are skipped, so delete whatever you do not want.
Keep clauses short. Consistency comes from: a locked look + studio setup + the same reference image
+ identical framing words + generating the whole batch in one round.

look.palette: warm neutral base with charcoal #26262B, sand #D9C7A7 and olive #6E7A5A accents
look.materials: real material micro-texture: grain, weave, brushed metal, matte ceramic

studio.scene: seamless light neutral studio background (#F4F2EE to #FFFFFF), identical across the batch
studio.style: premium commercial catalogue photography, crisp and clean
studio.lighting: large softbox key light slightly camera-left, soft fill, gentle contact shadow
studio.framing: centred product, camera at product mid-height, mild three-quarter angle, product fills about 75% of the frame

global_constraints: photographic realism with one consistent light direction
product colour and proportions true to the reference image
global_avoid: illegible or invented text on packaging
